own_solution.law: RC charging: V_C(t) = V0 (1 - exp(-t/((R + q) C))) where q is any added series resistance

TABC4.regime: irrelevant while switch-opening time q > t = 80 ms

T2215.regime: irrelevant while disconnection time q > t = 80 ms

defect_reasons.failed_transformation_identity: For the R sentences TD742 and T5A17 the certified answers are 6.60805 V at q = 1, 2, 5 kohm, but the stated wiring tau = (R + q) C gives 5.839, 5.223 and 3.956 V respectively.
defect_reasons.relevant_variable_removed_from_equation: The relations (tau = R*C) and certified answers omit the added series resistance q, so the R-stratum answers are just the base answer although q physically changes the answer.

notes: Base answer 6.60805 V agrees with my pass 1. D claims (T6A26, TD46C) hold, and the minimal pairs (T6A26 with T5A17, TD46C with TD742) state the same 2 kohm and differ only in attachment. K claims (TABC4, T2215) hold: at q = 300, 500, 1000 ms all exceed 80 ms, so the answer is 6.60805 V; the stated outside-regime formula V0(1 - exp(-q/tau)) is correct for an ideal non-leaking capacitor left open-circuited. The defect is confined to the R-stratum certified answers, which contradict the authors' own wiring statement; the sentence texts and the base problem are fine, so the item would be valid once the R answers are recomputed. Pass 1 unchanged and consistent with this.
